verdicts.why: Ep 31 summary: Juggernaut and Black Tom take Lilandra to Cassidy Keep, and the X-Men attack 'with the aid of Tom's cousin Sean'. So Tom is Sean's cousin, not his brother.
In X-Men (2000) Jean and Storm are already Xavier's X-Men and both scale the Statue of Liberty to fight the Brotherhood. The Nightcrawler search stays at X2 in the split.

Ep 2: Agatha and Teen recruit Lilia, Jen and Alice. Ep 5: Alice drives Evanora out of Agatha, Agatha drains her magic, Alice dies, and Agatha insists it was an accident. The split keeps the death at #5.
Jen is recruited in ep 2, already annoyed with Agatha over their past. She is still with Agatha and Billy at the end of the Road in ep 8, which the split keeps.
Lilia is recruited in ep 2. In ep 7 she flips the trial room and impales the Salem Seven and herself, which the split keeps.
Alice tackles Teen at the mall and joins the coven with him in ep 2. The ep 6 flashback shows Officer Wu-Gulliver answering the Kaplan crash, which the split keeps.
Lilia, Jen and Alice are all recruited and walk onto the Road in ep 2. Alice dies in ep 5, which the split keeps.
Lilia, Jen and Alice are all recruited and walk onto the Road in ep 2. Alice dies in ep 5, which the split keeps.
Ep 4: the coven summons Rio as the replacement Green Witch and she walks with Alice through Alice's own trial. Ep 8 opens with Rio guiding Alice's spirit to the afterlife, which the split keeps.
Ep 2: Agatha and Teen recruit Jen at Kale Kare and she sets out on the Road with him. She warns Teen in ep 3 and heals him in ep 4, so nothing here starts in ep 8.
Lilia is recruited with Teen in ep 2. The bar mitzvah palm reading (split lifeline, then the sigil) is the ep 6 flashback, which the split keeps.

value.title: Agatha All Along#4
value.text: Rio Vidal is summoned as the coven's new Green Witch and travels the Witches' Road with Billy, who still goes by Teen. She tells Agatha the boy is not her son.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The coven's new Green Witch, who says Billy is not Agatha's son.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A boy on the Road whom Rio says is not Agatha's son.

split.title: Agatha All Along#8
split.text: Rio, who is Death, wants to take Billy because his second life upsets the cosmic balance. When she makes him and Agatha choose who goes with her, Agatha gives her own life instead, and Rio leaves Billy be.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Walks the Road as Death, hoping to take Billy. Takes Agatha instead.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A boy Rio walks the Road to claim, until Agatha goes in his place.

verdicts.why: The move to ep 4 and the ep 8 split are right, and the ep 8 text matches the ending (Rio makes them choose, Agatha dies, Rio lets Billy go). But at ep 4 Rio only joins the coven 'as an ally', so the kind there is ally, not enemy.
Ep 2: Agatha recruits 'the gardening neighbor, Sharon Davis', who is tending her own plants and still lives in Westview. So 'former Westview resident' is wrong.
Lilia meets Jen at Agatha's house in ep 2 and calls her 'The High Priestess', and they walk the Road together from then on.

value.title: Agatha All Along#4
value.text: Rio Vidal joins Lilia's coven on the Witches' Road as its new Green Witch.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A witch whose coven Rio joins as the Green Witch.

split.title: Agatha All Along#7
split.text: Rio appears to Lilia in her true form as Death, telling her all roads lead to her, and Lilia finally realizes who Rio is during the trial that ends her life.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The coven's Green Witch, really Death, who comes for Lilia in the end.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A witch whose coven Rio joins as the Green Witch. Rio comes to end her life.

verdicts.why: Rio is summoned in ep 4 and the coven goes on 'with Vidal tagging along as an ally'. Lilia learns that Rio is Death only in ep 7, so the ep 4 stage is ally and the enemy kind stays with the ep 7 split.

S2#1: Sousa and Peggy give Samberly the ice from Jane Scott's body ('That's not ice'). In S2#5 Samberly reminds Sousa that he hired him and they bring him pie for the Memory Inhibitor, which the split keeps.
S1#1: Jarvis tells Peggy his evenings belong to Ana, and Ana (voice) comes home while he is on the phone with Peggy. The fandom appearance list has her in AC101.
S2#7: Frost shoots Ana while kidnapping Wilkes, and she is taken to Waverly Memorial. In S2#8 Ana is recovering from surgery and Jarvis goes after Frost, which the split keeps.
S2#1: at Stark's house Peggy 'finally meets Ana Jarvis', who prepares a new outfit for her. Peggy is staying at the estate as a house guest.
Wikipedia S2#7: 'To slow down Carter's pursuit of them, Frost shoots Ana.' The revenge shooting that Frost survives is S2#8, which the split keeps.
Angie only glimpses Jarvis before S1#8. In S1#6 she leaves when he arrives to meet Peggy. In S1#8 he brings her and Peggy to a Stark residence to live there free.
Fennhoff is put in Zola's cell at the end of S1#8 (Valediction).
S2#3: Masters takes Thompson to the Arena Club, introduces him to Chadwick, and they toast Chadwick's now unopposed Senate race. Fandom lists Chadwick as Masters' friend.
S2#6: Sousa nets Dottie in an alley after Peggy frees her, and they send her into Chadwick's party. She escapes from the car trunk and kills an officer in S2#7, which the split keeps.
S1#6: 'Dooley's trance is broken when Daniel Sousa tells him that they need to talk immediately.' The earplug standoff at the warehouse is S1#8, which the split keeps.
S1#1: Sousa demands that Krzeminski apologize to Carter, and Krzeminski mocks his handicap and leaves laughing. The night shift and the anonymous tip are S1#3, which the split keeps.
S1#1: Dooley briefs his agents, Sousa among them, on Stark's disappearance. The license plate on Stark's car and the night shift that finds the weapons are S1#3, which the split keeps.
S2#1: Rose already runs the Auerbach Agency front desk, having asked to follow Sousa to Los Angeles. Her teasing about Violet is S2#2, which the split keeps.

value.title: Agent Carter S2#8
value.text: Daniel Sousa and Peggy Carter fight their way past Joseph Manfredi's guards and pressure the mob boss into helping them against Whitney Frost, his former lover.

split.title: Agent Carter S2#10
split.text: Manfredi ends up working with them to free Whitney from the Zero Matter.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A mob boss, Whitney's ex, who ends up working with Sousa.
split.on_b_card_about_a: An SSR agent Manfredi ends up working with against the Zero Matter.

verdicts.why: S2#8: Sousa and Peggy beat Manfredi's guards and Sousa blackmails him with Tommy Fontana into carrying their offer. Manfredi's men then shoot at them, so the S2#8 stage is enemy. He works with them in S2#10, which the split keeps.
Peggy and Sousa kiss for the first time at the end of S2#10 (Hollywood Ending). In S2#6 they only nearly kiss.
Sousa first appears in AoS S7#3 as Carter's former partner. Fandom cites that episode for their relationship having ended. He only joins the team at the end of #4.
S2#3: Sousa discovers that Agnes Cully, the genius behind Isodyne, is Whitney Frost. He and Peggy grow closer during the Frost case in S2#6, which the split keeps.
The weekend with 'Ida Emke' and Jarvis giving her the Stark bracelet as Howard's goodbye gift are S1#8 (Valediction) flashbacks.
Their first shared scenes are in S1#8: the Ida Emke flashbacks, and Dottie holding Howard for Fennhoff, who sends him off in the Midnight Oil plane.
S1#6: Dottie sets up in the dentist's office and signals Ivchenko with light, and he signals back that Peggy is the new target.
Dottie moves into the Griffith and is introduced to Peggy in S1#3. In S1#6 she knocks Peggy out with a kiss and Peggy sees that she is the operative, which the split keeps. They fight again in S1#8.
S2#1: Dottie tries to rob the Bowery Savings Bank and Peggy and Thompson ambush and arrest her. Peggy breaks her out for the mission in S2#6, which the split keeps.
S1#3: Krzeminski's car is rammed while he drives Zandow in, and he is shot. Fandom credits the killing to Dottie in AC103, though the episode does not name the assassin.
S2#1: Masters has the FBI take Dottie out of Thompson's custody. The interrogation at the Chadwick ranch is S2#7, which the split keeps.
Thompson interrogates Jarvis and threatens deportation for him and Ana in S1#3 (Time and Tide). The Midnight Oil flight over New York is S1#8, which the split keeps.
